package.description: Open-source visual AI agent app built on Pi, no terminal required.

en-US.description: Open-source visual AI agent app built on Pi, no terminal required.
en-US.longDescription: OpenPipal is an open-source visual desktop app built on the Pi agent framework. Create dedicated agents from real conversations, extend them with plugins, Agent Skills, MCP servers, and detected CLI tools, and run work manually, on a schedule, or through webhooks on macOS and Windows.
en-US.name: OpenPipal

zh-CN.description: 基于 Pi 的开源可视化 AI Agent 应用，无需命令行。
zh-CN.longDescription: OpenPipal 是构建在 Pi Agent 框架上的开源可视化桌面应用，可从真实对话创建专属 Agent，通过插件、Agent Skills、MCP 服务器和检测到的 CLI 工具扩展能力，并支持手动、定时或 Webhook 触发自动化任务，适用于 macOS 与 Windows。
